question: What power arises for those contemplating the self-born Śiva-energy of the golden-limbed pair?
premises: The golden-limbed pair embodies a self-born Śiva-power
Contemplation of that power is undertaken by a practitioner
Such contemplation yields a specific capacity
inference: Contemplating the self-born Śiva-power of the golden-limbed pair grants a potent spiritual capacity.
uncertainties: Identity of the golden-limbed pair is not explicit
plain_english: For one who contemplates the self-born Śiva-power of the golden-limbed pair, a special power arises.
